label: ship types
eval: (() => { const out = {}; for (const p of __map.map.plates.values()) out[p.ship.design.name] = (out[p.ship.design.name] ?? 0) + 1; return JSON.stringify(out); })()

label: the fleet: ships per side and class
eval: (() => { const out = {}; for (const p of __map.map.plates.values()) { const s = p.ship; const k = s.side + ' ' + s.cls; out[k] = (out[k] ?? 0) + 1; } return JSON.stringify({ ships: __map.map.plates.size, byKind: out, battleShips: __map.map.battle.ships.length }); })()

label: every deck sits on its hull: deck inside the hull's footprint, hull top under the deck
eval: (() => { const bad = []; for (const p of __map.map.plates.values()) { const deck = new __map.map.THREE.Box3().setFromObject(p.base); const hull = new __map.map.THREE.Box3().setFromObject(p.shipGroup); if (!(hull.min.x <= deck.min.x + 0.01 && hull.max.x >= deck.max.x - 0.01 && hull.min.z <= deck.min.z + 0.01 && hull.max.z >= deck.max.z - 0.01)) bad.push(p.key); } return JSON.stringify({ checked: __map.map.plates.size, outside: bad }); })()

label: every deck corner has its own hull under it (a ray straight down from each corner hits the ship)
eval: (() => { const m = __map.map; const T = m.THREE; const ray = new T.Raycaster(); const bad = []; for (const p of m.plates.values()) { const b = new T.Box3().setFromObject(p.base); const meshes = p.shipGroup.children.filter((c) => c.isMesh); for (const [x, z] of [[b.min.x + 0.5, b.min.z + 0.5], [b.max.x - 0.5, b.min.z + 0.5], [b.min.x + 0.5, b.max.z - 0.5], [b.max.x - 0.5, b.max.z - 0.5]]) { ray.set(new T.Vector3(x, -0.1, z), new T.Vector3(0, -1, 0)); if (!ray.intersectObjects(meshes, false).length) { bad.push(p.key + ' ' + p.ship.design.name); break; } } } return JSON.stringify({ checked: m.plates.size, overhanging: bad }); })()

(() => { const m = __map.map; const p = m.plates.get('Commands/Add task'); const c = p.shipGroup.position.clone(); m.flyTo(new (m.camera.position.constructor)(c.x + 60, 40, c.z + 140), c); return 'ok'; })()
